name: Dalaran
summary: On Lordamere Lake, Dalaran's surviving magi are rebuilding their shattered city. Once the shining capital of the Kirin Tor, it fell to the Scourge and Archimonde during the Third War. Its protective violet shield has been removed.

sections.title: Fall of the Magocracy
sections.body:
Dalaran began as a sanctuary for arcane study, founded by sorcerers of the Arathorian Empire after the ancient Troll Wars. For centuries, it was humanity's foremost center of magic. The Council of Six led the Kirin Tor, keeping vast archives and powerful artifacts in the Violet Citadel.

That age ended during the Third War. The traitor prince Arthas led the Scourge through the city gates to seize the Book of Medivh. Soon after, the demon lord Archimonde crushed Dalaran's soaring spires into rubble.

sections.title: Rebuilding the Magocracy
sections.body: After the Legion's defeat, the Kirin Tor's surviving wizards returned to their devastated homeland. They would not yield their ancestral ground to the Scourge or scavengers, and raised a shimmering violet barrier over the city's heart. The shield has since been removed, while rebuilding continues. The magi are restoring their fallen sanctuary, and Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver can be found in the Violet Citadel.

faq.q: What became of Dalaran's protective shield?
faq.answer: After Dalaran's destruction in the Third War, the Kirin Tor raised a magical shield over the city. The shield has since been removed, and rebuilding continues.

Yes. Reconstruction is underway, and Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver resides in the Violet Citadel. The Kirin Tor sides with the Alliance, and the Horde is Hated by them and attacked on sight in the city. Horde groups can still enter the City of Dalaran dungeon.
Prince Arthas and his Scourge army attacked Dalaran and stole the Book of Medivh from its vaults. Soon after, the demon lord Archimonde used dark sorcery to pulverize the city into ruins.
The Kirin Tor governs Dalaran through its ruling assembly, the Council of Six.

angles.text: As a mage, you look to Dalaran as the historic cradle of human and high elven wizardry. Its legendary spires are still being rebuilt, a solemn reminder of the losses mages suffered in the Third War.

As an Alliance member, you can trace Dalaran's place in your history to its role as one of the seven founding kingdoms of the original Alliance of Lordaeron. The Kirin Tor is rebuilding its devastated capital.
